in_sanskrit.name: Kenika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Kali's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kenika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kenika is derived from the Sanskrit name 'Kali', which represents the divine mother and the goddess of time, change, and destruction. The prefix 'Keni' denotes grace, kindness, and compassion, making Kenika a powerful name that embodies the blessings of the goddess Kali.
